keepassux.name: KeepassUX
keepassux.description: Password manager built using the open-source KeePass library

detail.overview: KeepassUX is a Flutter mobile app that brings the KeePass password-management ecosystem to a clean, modern interface. It works directly with the KDBX format used by KeePass, so existing databases can be opened and managed without switching ecosystems, all while keeping security as the top priority.
features: Open, create, and manage KDBX password databases
Full entry and group management with drag-and-drop organization
Recycle bin with soft delete, restore, and permanent delete
Biometric unlock and encrypted local storage
Built-in password generator with strength analysis
Screenshot blocking for extra privacy
Light and dark themes, with English and Spanish localization

ugc_database.name: UGC Database
ugc_database.description: Platform that helps agencies find and hire content creators for advertising through advanced search and filtering.

detail.overview: An internal platform built for advertising agencies to discover, vet, and hire user-generated-content creators for their campaigns. It centralizes creator sourcing that would otherwise be scattered across spreadsheets and social media into a single searchable database.
features: Advanced creator search with filters by niche, location, and engagement
Centralized creator profile database
Campaign and content brief management
Messaging and collaboration workflow between agencies and creators
Admin dashboard with usage analytics

berrly.name: Berrly
berrly.description: Management system for clubs, associations, and foundations, including event organization and ticket management

detail.overview: Berrly is a cloud-based management platform used by clubs, associations, and foundations to run their day-to-day operations. It's used by over 500,000 people every day, combining CRM and ERP style tools for member management, communication, billing, and events. I worked on the mobile app that lets members stay connected on the go.
features: GDPR-compliant member database with smart tagging and segmentation
Event organization with real-time attendance tracking (Berrly Scan)
Mass communications via email, SMS, and push notifications
Recurring billing with SEPA file generation for banks
Member mobile app with digital membership cards
Open API for third-party integrations

bovidata.name: Bovidata
bovidata.description: Livestock management system with features for health tracking, inventory management, expense tracking, and more

detail.overview: Bovidata applies data science to livestock farming, giving farmers a practical way to manage their herds from a mobile app. It's available on iOS and Android and is used to keep detailed, centralized records that would otherwise live in scattered notebooks and spreadsheets.
features: Animal records including age, weight, breed, and health history
Vaccination and treatment scheduling with reminders
Real-time statistics and graphs on weight and growth
Centralized farm data management across the whole herd
Cross-platform mobile app for iOS and Android
